dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 13, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Tigers Shut Down Guardians, While Reds and Pirates Cruise to Victories**

In a shutout win for the Detroit Tigers, Parker Messick pitched 5.2 innings, striking out six batters and allowing two earned runs, but ultimately took the loss. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians with a home run and RBI, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Tigers' strong pitching performance. In a 9-8 win for the Cincinnati Reds, Eugenio Suárez hit a home run and drove in four runs, while Tejay Antone earned the save with three strikeouts in one inning. Rafael Flores Jr. of the Pittsburgh Pirates hit two home runs and drove in six runs in a 13-1 thrashing of the Miami Marlins.
